content: Hey Jess, how was your day? Did you survive all those back-to-back meetings?
It was nonstop, as usual. Honestly, talking to you is the best part of my day.
Aww, you always make me smile. I wish I could just whisk you away from all that stress. We deserve a little break, don't you think?
You have no idea how much I wish that too. Maybe someday soon?
Sooner than you think! I actually have some news to share. My international real estate deal finally got the green light, and I want you to be a part of it.
Wait, really? That's amazing! What does it mean for you?

It means everything I've been working for is about to pay off, and I want to make sure you benefit too. But there's one snag: the local authorities require a $4,800 licensing fee before releasing the contract funds.
Oh wow. That sounds frustrating. Is there anything you can do?
I've tried everything. My funds are tied up until the deal closes. If I can cover the fee, I'll get a $180,000 payout, and I want to split it with you for everything you've done for me.
That's really generous, but I don't know if I have that kind of money.
Jess, I'd never put you in a bad spot. If you can help, I'll return it plus a $10,000 bonus in just a week. You trust me, right?
I do trust you, I just get nervous about money stuff.

That's understandable, and I'd feel the same. But this is completely safe, I can send you my attorney's documents if that helps. All you'd need to do is transfer the funds via Zelle or, if you prefer, Bitcoin. Which would be easier for you?
I think Zelle would be easier for me. What info do you need?
Perfect. Just use this email: estatefunds@consultmail.com on Zelle, and it'll go straight to my attorney's holding account. Let me know when you send it so I can confirm right away.
Okay, I'll log into my bank and see how much I can send now. I might need to split it over two days.
That's totally fine, Jess. I just appreciate you helping me. Let me know if your bank asks for any details, the payment is for 'consulting services,' so no red flags.
Got it. I'll start the transfer and let you know when it's done.
Thank you, Jess. This means so much to me. Once the deal finalizes, I'll fly you out and we'll finally celebrate together.
I can't wait! I'll message you as soon as I finish the transfer.
You're incredible. I'll be right here. If anything feels weird with the bank, just let me know, my attorney can talk to them too.
Alright, I'm sending the first half now.
All set! I see the notification. You're a lifesaver, Jess. We're so close to our new life.
